exposure: mode of delivery (cesarean section, vaginal delivery, oxytocin induction)
cohort: The study participants were 205 newborns hospitalized with jaundice at Zakho General Hospital in Iraq.
finding: The study identified male children and oxytocin infusion as main predictors for neonatal jaundice, showing a significant difference in jaundice severity between children born by oxytocin induction and those born spontaneously.
mod_finding: Jaundice severity differed significantly between children born by oxytocin induction and those born spontaneously, but no significant difference was observed regarding anesthesia techniques.
